name: Twistlock - Defender Incidents
description: The Twistlock - Defender Incidents dashboard combines high-level and detailed information for defender incidents—logical groupings of events related by context that reveal attack known patterns. The dashboard is organized by incidents that reveal known attack patterns and process activity audits. Panels show information on the number of defender incidents, incident categories, recent incidents, and processes spawned on containers.
title: Twistlock - Defender Incidents

queries.queryString:
_sourceCategory = Labs/Twistlock incident incident_category
| parse regex "\s+(?<component>Twistlock-Console|Twistlock-Defender?)\s*.*\s*time=\"" nodrop
| parse "type=\"*\"" as type nodrop | parse "host=\"*\"" as host nodrop | parse "incident_category=\"*\"" as incident_category nodrop 
| parse "service_name=\"*\"" as service_name nodrop | parse "container_id=\"*\"" as container_id nodrop | parse "image_name=\"*\"" as image_name nodrop
| where type="incident"
| count as incidents

_sourceCategory = Labs/Twistlock incident incident_category
| parse regex "\s+(?<component>Twistlock-Console|Twistlock-Defender?)\s*.*\s*time=\"" nodrop
| parse "type=\"*\"" as type nodrop | parse "host=\"*\"" as host nodrop | parse "incident_category=\"*\"" as incident_category nodrop 
| parse "service_name=\"*\"" as service_name nodrop | parse "container_id=\"*\"" as container_id nodrop | parse "image_name=\"*\"" as image_name nodrop
| where type="incident"
| count as incidents by incident_category
| sort by incidents, incident_category asc
| limit 10

panels.title: Note
panels.text:
Defender Incidents are logical groupings of events related by context that reveal known attack patterns.


The Process Activity Audit section records processes activity spawned in a container.


interactive field represents whether the process was spawned from a shell session: true or false

queries.queryString:
_sourceCategory = Labs/Twistlock incident incident_category
| parse regex "\s+(?<component>Twistlock-Console|Twistlock-Defender?)\s*.*\s*time=\"" nodrop
| parse "type=\"*\"" as type nodrop | parse "host=\"*\"" as host nodrop | parse "incident_category=\"*\"" as incident_category nodrop 
| parse "service_name=\"*\"" as service_name nodrop | parse "container_id=\"*\"" as container_id nodrop | parse "image_name=\"*\"" as image_name nodrop
| where type="incident"
| timeslice 1s
| count as incidents by _timeslice, component, type, host, incident_category, service_name, container_id, image_name
| sort by _timeslice

_sourceCategory = Labs/Twistlock Twistlock-Defender type process interactive
| parse regex "\s+(?<component>Twistlock-Console|Twistlock-Defender?)\s*.*\s*time=\"" nodrop | parse "type=\"*\"" as type nodrop | parse "pid=\"*\"" as pid nodrop | parse "path=\"*\"" as path nodrop | parse "interactive=\"*\"" as interactive nodrop | parse "md5=\"*\"" as md5 nodrop | parse "container_id=\"*\"" as container_id nodrop 
| where type="process"
| count as spawnedFreq by path, interactive
| sort by spawnedFreq, path asc, interactive

panels.title: Number of Distinct Processes Spawned on Container - Trend

queries.queryString:
_sourceCategory = Labs/Twistlock Twistlock-Defender type process interactive
| parse regex "\s+(?<component>Twistlock-Console|Twistlock-Defender?)\s*.*\s*time=\"" nodrop | parse "type=\"*\"" as type nodrop | parse "pid=\"*\"" as pid nodrop | parse "path=\"*\"" as path nodrop | parse "interactive=\"*\"" as interactive nodrop | parse "md5=\"*\"" as md5 nodrop | parse "container_id=\"*\"" as container_id nodrop 
| where type="process"
| timeslice 5m
| count_distinct(pid) as uniqueProcessIds by _timeslice, container_id
| transpose row _timeslice column container_id
